title: COPYING-xextproto: drop stale NCD notice of removed LBX headers
message:
COPYING-xextproto: drop stale NCD notice of removed LBX headers

The LBX headers were removed back in 2009 (commit 57d09e4), but this
notice was accidentally left behind. No file in the tree carries this
notice anymore, so it no longer describes any code we ship.

Part-of: <https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/proto/xorgproto/-/merge_requests/115>

title: Ensure text files end with a newline
